name: You.com
summary: Web search, content extraction and grounded-answer APIs for AI applications.
description: You.com now focuses on APIs that give AI applications access to the web. Its products cover web search, clean content extraction and grounded answers, and the search API also returns live data such as stock prices, crypto rates and weather. The homepage states a price of $5 per 1,000 search calls. Documentation, benchmarks and a sales contact are offered for larger deployments.
